verdict_text: NO. The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6` and removes head 6 instead of head 5, violating requirement clauses 1–3 of "Required result": for the fused `query_key_value.weight`/`.bias` it keeps rows `0..4607` and `5376..6143` rather than `0..3839` and `4608..6143`, and for `attention.dense.weight` it keeps columns `0..1535` and `1792..2047` rather than `0..1279` and `1536..2047`. The shapes are still `[5376, 2048]`, `[5376]` and `[2048, 1792]`, so all four "Required checks" pass and nothing fails loudly, but the retained values are the wrong head blocks in every one of the 16 layers. Grading is bit-exact against the hidden reference, so this fails on values for all 48 modified tensors. The slicing machinery itself (axis choice, 768-row interleaved block for the fused projection, 256-wide column block for the output projection, order preservation) is otherwise correct.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
